answer: Invitations form a tree with a quota of 5 children per node, and one upheld challenge revokes the whole branch above the offender, so buying 200 accounts down a single chain loses the chain on one report. In 900 invites we saw 2 revocations, a nadir for the farm and nothing lost for the tree; resold invites in a karst of aliases were the only leak, and each of those needed a lantern, meaning an outside auditor who gained nothing by approving it.
